outcome: Efficacy of laparoscopy and hysteroscopy for treatment of CSP
Clinical factors associated with successful treatment selection
cohort: 112 women with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated at a hospital in China between December 2014 and December 2017
finding: Both laparoscopy and hysteroscopy are safe and effective minimally invasive procedures for treating CSP, with days of amenorrhea, gestational sac diameter, and myometrial thickness being key factors for selecting the appropriate surgical approach.
